title: Farewells
label: ch:farewells
canDo: I can end a French conversation politely and choose a farewell that fits the situation.

payoff.summary: You can open a French conversation; now close it. French has one plain goodbye and a small family of soft ones, all built the same way — the preposition à (“to”) followed by a time word — and this chapter also teaches the accents, the cedilla and the trema you have been reading all along.
payoff.note: Chapter 4 is schema-v2 as of the handwritten-chapter retirement. FR-C04-practice assesses the six farewell atoms; the three accent-mark atoms (FR-SCRIPT-ACCENTS-07, FR-SCRIPT-CIRCUMFLEX-08, FR-SCRIPT-CEDILLE-09, FR-SCRIPT-TREMA-10) are assessed in their own writing lessons, which the handwritten chapter did not print at all.
